title: php-forge site — gallery, SEO, and layout
stub: Wrapped the public site into its own project: meta tags, showcase layout, and polish.
content:
Documented the forge site as a project in php-forge — appropriate, since the site is built on itself.

Recent work on this pass:

  • SEO — per-page descriptions, canonical URLs on the primary domain, Open Graph and Twitter cards, keywords from site config plus entry tags, /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt
  • Home and contact — about copy, Discord invite, maker-friendly contact page
  • Project pages — progress, finished/to-do lists, optional link from updates; screenshot showcase with a main image, thumbnails, and click-to-zoom (portrait mobile shots finally behave)
  • Branding — logo slot in the header, wider layout, panel styling on home

Still on the list: a real OG banner image, more documented builds, maybe tag filters. The engine note from June 1 still describes the basics; this update is the polish layer.
